create_idefics2_model: create an Idefics2ForConditionalGeneration model with a SigLIP vision encoder and Mistral language decoder for multimodal generation
run_image_feature_extraction: run the get_image_features method to extract image hidden states from pixel values through the vision encoder and perceiver resampler
build_multimodal_forward_pass: build a forward pass that merges text token embeddings with image hidden states and feeds them to the language model decoder
test_conditional_generation: test the forward pass of Idefics2ForConditionalGeneration with pixel values, input_ids, and labels to compute the language modeling loss
review_perceiver_resampler: review the Idefics2PerceiverResampler class that compresses long-form image context using cross-attention with fixed learnable latents
